# Junk in the Truck Co

> Tampa Bay junk removal, dumpster rental and light demolition. Fast, affordable, same-day service. Call 844-858-6546.

Junk in the Truck Co is a locally owned, licensed and insured junk removal and demolition company serving Tampa, South Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, Riverview, Town 'n' Country, Carrollwood, Temple Terrace, and Westchase, FL. We handle residential and commercial jobs, recycle and donate whenever possible, and provide free on-site estimates.

## Other Services

- [Dumpster Rental](/services/dumpster-rental/): Roll-off dumpster rental in two sizes, 15-yard and 20-yard. Flat rates: 15-yard $400 for 3 days, $450 for 7 days, $475 for 14 days, $500 for 30 days. 20-yard $450 for 3 days, $525 for 7 days, $550 for 14 days, $600 for 30 days. Every rental includes 1 ton of disposal, with additional weight at $0.06 per pound over 1 ton. There is no online booking for dumpsters — call 844-858-6546 or text 813-531-9858. Accepted: household junk and furniture, mattresses, yard waste, wood and lumber, drywall, cabinets, flooring, and general remodeling debris. Appliances and refrigerators are accepted but additional fees may apply depending on location, and tires are accepted with additional disposal fees — contact us before putting appliances or tires in a dumpster. Small amounts of roofing shingles are OK. Full roof tear-offs aren't accepted. Call or text us first if you're not sure. Not accepted: wet or liquid paint, concrete, dirt. Placement: driveway placement is available, street placement only where regulations permit and may require local permits; driveway protection is available on request; delivery needs suitable ground and clearance.
